basics.name: Karlo Benčić
basics.label: Software Architect & AI Engineer
basics.summary: Software Architect and AI Engineer with 13+ years of experience across cloud architecture, AI engineering, full-stack systems, and DevOps. Currently building AI-native engineering platforms, architecting autonomous coding agents, multi-agent code review systems, MCP tooling, and enterprise RAG pipelines while leading architecture for AI-powered legal tech, compliance, and trust infrastructure products. Proven track record leading enterprise software initiatives, designing resilient microservices, and shipping solutions across LegalTech, InsurTech, GovTech, and eCommerce (.NET, TypeScript, React, React Native, Azure, AWS). Founder of NextLevel Dev software consultancy and creator of 20+ published games with 5M+ players. By combining my academic background in model-driven architectures and domain-driven methodologies with an entrepreneurial mindset, I offer deep expertise in product development and understanding of existing solutions in relation to the current technological landscape.
